questions.question: Side-selling history in an outgrower scheme, or no mechanism to stop it?
Disputes over land occupation or water rights?
A single crop sold to a single uncontracted buyer?
Production figures that cannot be matched to delivery notes or buyer statements?
Rain-fed production only: crop insurance on the financed crop with Crowdaxe as loss payee in place?
A single critical imported input with no FX source and no local substitute?
Plant older than its economic life with no maintenance capex budget?
Dependence on one retail chain or distributor for over 50% of sales?
Products competing directly with duty-free or informal imports?
No generator or solar backup power? (input and power security at least 7)
Invoices that cannot be confirmed by the buyer, or duplicate invoices across lenders?
Circular trades with related parties to inflate turnover?
Customs or ZIMRA disputes over import duties?
Stock counts that do not reconcile to purchase and sales records?
Invoice programmes: each invoice verified with the buyer before funding?
Invoice programmes: no related-party invoices?
Invoice programmes: no debtor above 25% of the pool unless graded 1-4?
Invoice programmes: invoices under 90 days old?
Invoice programmes: dilution (credit notes, returns) below 5%?
Vehicles registered or held outside Zimbabwe, or in an owner's personal name?
No comprehensive insurance, including goods-in-transit cover?
Repeated cargo theft or accident claims?
Revenue concentrated in one route that depends on a single border post?
Vehicles lack GPS tracking or documented maintenance records? (fleet quality 2 points weaker)
Vehicle finance tenor within the remaining economic life of the financed vehicles?
No title deeds, or title held by a party other than the borrower?
Unapproved building plans or outstanding council rates?
Leases in ZiG with no USD indexation, against USD debt?
A valuation commissioned by the borrower rather than by Crowdaxe Capital?
Secondary town, or no municipal water and sewer services? (sub-sector +1)
Single tenant graded 1-4 on a lease longer than the loan tenor? (tenant score 3)
Independent valuation (Valuers Council of Zimbabwe), dated within 12 months, in USD?
Disputes with parents or regulators over fee levels?
Governance conflicts between a trust board, a church and management?
Fee arrears rising for two terms in a row?
Capex that does not raise income or cut costs, funded with short-tenor debt?
Enrolment falling by more than 10% a year? (enrolment scores 9-10)
Enrolment above 95% but no waiting list? (enrolment no better than 3, PROPOSED item 8)
No independent yield study, or yields above comparable plants in the same area?
PPA terminable by the offtaker without compensation?
Grid connection or ZERA licensing not yet secured?
Equipment imported without warranty registration in Zimbabwe?
Pre-sales or pre-lets of at least 50% of area?
Loan to cost at or below 60%?
Stabilised DSCR at or above 1.30x?
Sponsor operates an existing school?
Applications at or above 50% of year-1 capacity?
Feedstock contracts cover at least 60% of input needs over the tenor?
Pre-lets of at least 60% of area?
No independent yield study, or yields above comparable plants in the same area?
PPA terminable by the offtaker without compensation?
Grid connection or ZERA licensing not yet secured?
Equipment imported without warranty registration in Zimbabwe?
PPA tenor runs less than 2 years beyond loan maturity? (offtaker 2 points weaker)
Signed PPA in place?
Grid connection agreed?
Licence obtained?
